verdict.rationale: AFK models each task as a directed graph whose blocked nodes resume automatically when dependencies clear, and whose writes pause for human sign-off. That implies processes can sit waiting and later continue, but nothing documents durable state persistence or recovery after restarts, and it is pitched at business-ops users, not developers authoring workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of state surviving worker/platform restarts, documented multi-day timers or waits, a developer-facing workflow API or SDK (OpenAPI probes return 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
